title: The Restless Effect
description:
## Fix the Bug: The Restless Effect

`Logger` lists `config` in its dependency array. Yet bumping the counter causes the Logger to fire its effect over and over. Open the preview — the counter visible at the top is "how many times the Logger effect has fired since you opened the page."

### Symptoms
- Click the **+** button a few times — `#fires` grows by one with each click, even though `config` is just `{ level: 'info' }` and never actually changes

### Your Task
Make the Logger’s effect fire **only once on mount**, and never again from unrelated re-renders.

> **Think about it:** `{}` is a new object on every render. React’s dependency array uses `Object.is` to compare. A "shape-equal" object isn’t reference-equal. Which hook gives you a stable reference between renders?
